answer: Make identity cost irrecoverable machine time. A newcomer must finish a long cumulative workload whose cost curve looks like cutting a channel through basalt: slow, sunk, useless to fake at scale. Until that deposit matures the key earns nothing, so ten thousand puppets cost what one honest miner pays ten thousand times. Trust then grows like a meadow around paths people actually walked. A verification prism splits each claim into separate views - latency, memory shape, past attestations - and peers cross-check them; one operator driving many accounts makes those views disagree.
